name: Leviton
old_description: Manufactures electrical wiring devices including switches, sockets, and outlets.
about:
Leviton was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Melville, New York. The company has remained a privately held manufacturer of electrical wiring devices for over a century.

Leviton manufactures a broad range of electrical products including switches, dimmers, outlets, lighting controls, AFCI breakers, fusion splicing solutions, load centers, and data center infrastructure. The company also develops the My Leviton app for unified smart home control of lighting, load management, and EV charging. Recent investments include a $100 million global capital expansion to accelerate AI and smart building network infrastructure, as well as increased high-fiber-count production capacity for data center deployments.

Leviton serves the electrical, lighting, data networking, and energy management sectors. Its customer base includes residential homeowners and installers, commercial and industrial facilities, data center operators, utility companies for submetering, and marine applications for dockside power. The Leviton Load Center is designed for residential new builds, while the Series 2500 submeter targets utility energy management, and the Arc-Arrest pin-and-sleeve devices address marine and industrial power connections.

The company emphasizes its 120-year legacy of quality, safety, and forward-thinking design as a differentiator, citing trusted engineering, real-world insight, and customer-focused partnership. Leviton has also committed to achieving company-wide carbon neutrality by 2030.
